svg.title: LLM4Security
svg.desc: Do multi-agent LLM pipelines find hardware security bugs better, or just spend more compute? In an 80-run pilot, the pipeline caught 90% of cases against 65% for a single tool-using agent: +25 points. 84 benchmark cases.
svg.text: Do multi-agent LLM pipelines find hardware bugs
better, or just spend more compute?
